description: The file is a shell script for testing and automating interactions with a Git and Perforce integration, specifically testing P4 jobs and commits.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4_add_job
methods.description: Adds a new job to Perforce with the specified identifier.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up or verifies the Perforce client view pattern.

methods.name: p4 fix
methods.description: Associates a job with a specific changelist in Perforce.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository, using specific options.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up Git workspace after tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for verification.
